results.title: Apple teases Severance season 3 in new update
results.description: The wait between Severance’s first two seasons was long, and season 3 has demanded a lot of patience too, but Apple TV just teased a noteworthy update on the show’s progress.

results.title: Jefferson Lab to Receive New Funding for Work on Genesis Mission Projects
results.description: NEWPORT NEWS, Va., July 27, 2026 — The U.S. Department of Energy has announced Phase I Request for Application (RFA) funding awards for small interdisciplinary teams to address Genesis Mission National Science and Technology Challenges.
